name: terminal-buddy
description: For non-developers using Claude Code, Codex, or any AI coding tool: translates scary error messages and failed terminal commands into plain English automatically (what broke, why, how to fix it, and can apply the fix), asks for confirmation with a plain-English explanation and an automatic local git checkpoint before risky commands run (rm -rf, force-push, dropped tables, disk formats, and more), and keeps every response short, plain, and jargon-free by default, not just error explanations. Includes a standalone explain-error CLI usable outside Claude entirely.
